sanskrit: sarvasiddhipradāṃ devīṃ namāmi parameśvarīmprasīda guhyavaktrānta kathayasva priyaṃvadatat prakāśaya guhyākhyaṃ yacca tvaṃ mama vallabhastrīsvabhāvānmahattattva na jānāsi śubhapradamtava bhaktyā bhaviṣyāmi bhāvanā mantrasiddhidāmantro yo gururevāsau yo guruḥ sā ca devatābhairavī chinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī tathāetā daśa mahāvidyāḥ siddhavidyāḥ prakīrtitāḥetāśca paramā vidyāstriṣu lokeṣu durlabhāḥyena yena prakāreṇa siddhiryāsyati bhūtalenaiva siddhādyapekṣā'sti nakṣatrādivicāraṇāsiddhavidyā mahāvidyā yugasevā pariśramamyā kālī paramā vidyā [ saiva tārā prakrīrtitāetayorbhedabhāvena (sarve) nānāmantrā bhavanti hiṣoḍaśī yā mahāvidyā caturdhā kathitā purābhuvaneśvarī tryakṣarī tu mahāvidyā prakīrtitāidānīṃ taddayābhāvāt kathayāṅandasundaraārādhitā ca vidyeyaṃ vajreṇa nāma mohitākāmarājākhyavidyā yā vidyā sā puṣpadhanvanākumārī yā ca vidyeyaṃ tayā śaptā bahiścyutātayā pratiṣṭhitā vidyā tārā candrasvarūpiṇīchinnamastā surāmāṃsapriyā raktasvarūpiṇībagalāvaśyastambhādinānāguṇasamanvitājīvaputraistu dhanadā pāṣāṇaiḥ sarvabhogadākevalā tu mahāsampaddāyinī sukhamokṣadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: || iti dvitīye muṇḍamālātantre prathamaḥ paṭalaḥakṣamāleti kiṃ nāma phalaṃ kiṃ vā vadasvamebhavanti śṛṇu tat prauḍhe vistārāducyate mayāādināntaḥkṣādikāntaḥkrameṇa parameśvarimeruhīnā ca yā mālā merulaṅghyā ca yā bhavetcitrāṇī viśatantvābhā brahmanāḍīgatāntarāaṣṭottaraśatajapādādau klībaṃ samācaretvargāṇāmaṣṭabhirvāpi kāmyabhedakrameṇa tusphāṭikairmokṣadā proktā padmākṣairbahuputradāśmaśānadhūsturairmālā caikā dhūmāvatīvidhausarvasiddhapradā mokṣadāyinī varavarṇinisadā gopyaṃ prayatnena mātuśca jāravat priyemauktikairgrathitā mālā sarvaiśvaryaphalapradāmālā kāryā kuśagranthyā sarvayajñaphalapradātriṃśataiśvaryaphaladā pañcaviṃśena mokṣadāpañcadaśātmikā devi māraṇoccāṭane sthitāpādukāsiddhisaṅghe ca śataṃ saṅkhyā prakīrtitānityaṃ japaṃ kare kuryānna tu kāmyaṃ kadācanatatrāṅgulijapaṃ kurvan sāṅguṣṭhāṅgulibhirjapetanāmikādvayaṃ parva kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa tumeruṃ pradakṣiṇīkurvan anāmāmūlaparvataḥārabhyā'nāmikāmūlāt prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa tutarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japed daśasu parvasuanāmāmadhyaparvaṃ tu meruṃ kṛtvā na laṅghayetcatvāri tasya naśyanti āyurvidyā yaśo balam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athātaḥ prathamaṃ vakṣye mālānāṃ tantrabodhanamvijane prajapenmaunī svayaṃ mālāṃ ca sādhakaḥyathākālaṃ yathālābhamakṣāṇyānīya yatnataḥkīṭādibhiraduṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni catato dvijendrapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ granthivarjitamśuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ śāntivaśyābhicārakesūtraṃ maṇīṃśca gandhāntaiḥ kṣālitāstatra nikṣipetśuddhodakena ratnena kastūrīkuṅkumena cavinyasya pūjayedājyairjuhuyāccaiva yatnataḥmaṇimekaikamādāya sūtre sampātayet sudhīḥgopucchasadṛśī kāryā'thavā sarpākṛtirbhavetekaikamaṇimadhye tu brahmagranthiṃ prakalpayetkṣālayet pañcagavyena sadyojātena tajjalaiḥbhave bhavasya māṃ bhavodbhavaḥcandanāgurugandhādyairvāmadevena gharṣayetnama unmattāya unmanāya namo namaḥoṃ ghorebhyo'ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥoṃ tatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahimantrayet pañcamenaiva pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śatambrahmaṇo'dhipatirbrahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ śivaḥ pañca sadāśivaḥmeruṃ ca pañcamenaiva tato mantreṇa mantrayetmūlamantreṇa deveśi sampūjya bhaktibhāvataḥaśucirna spṛśedenāṃ karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayettarjanyāṃ na spṛśedenāṃ gurorapi na darśayettarjanīmāraṇādiṣṭakaniṣṭhāmāraṇaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāntu japed vaśye tu karmaṇikaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogācca japenmāraṇakarmaṇijapakāle tu goptavyā japamālā tu sā śubhāakṣamālāṃ ca vidyāṃ ca na kadācit prakāśayetharanti prakaṭāt siddhiṃ tasmād guptiṃ sadā kurupramādāt patitāddhastāt śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japetsadā gopyā prayatnena yadi tvaṃ mama vallabhā|| iti dvitīye muṇḍamālātantre dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥsadācāryaṃ vinā yena sarvamantrāḥ susiddhagāḥmahāliṅge parvate vā devāgāre catuṣpathesaṃgrāmabhūmau yonau tu sthale vā vijane vanesthānaṃ te kathitaṃ devi āsanaṃ kathyate'dhunāmeṣacarma tathoccāṭe khaḍgīyaṃ vaśyakarmaṇivyāghrājine sarvasiddhirjñānasiddhirmṛgājineraktaṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇaṃ viśeṣād raktakambalamdharaṇyāṃ duḥkhasambhūtiḥ pāṣāṇe rogasambhavaḥmṛdukambalamāstīrṇaṃ saṃgrāme patitaṃ hi tatgarbhacyutatvacaṃ vāpi nārīṇāṃ yonijāṃ tvacamtvacaṃ vā yonisaṃsthāyāḥ kuryād vīro ratāsanamnā'dīkṣito viśejjātu kṛṣṇasārāsane gṛhīkuśājināmbaraiḥ kāryaṃ caturasraṃ samantantaḥviśuddha āsane kuryāt saṃskāraṃ pūjanaṃ budhaḥpadmāsanamiti prāhuḥ sarvaiśvaryaphalapradamūrdhvapādau sthitau devi nirodhaḥ parimaṇḍitamsarvāsanānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi devairapi suduṣkaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pīṭhānāṃ devi sarveṣāṃ caturddhā pīṭhamuttamamjālandharaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ tathā pūrṇācalaṃ matamkṛte jālandharaṃ jñeyaṃ tretāyāṃ pūrṇaparvatammahāphalapradaṃ loke tatkṣaṇāt siddhidaṃ mahatyonirūpeṇa yatrāste svayaṃ koṭiguṇātmikākathitaṃ pūrvamasmabhyaṃ prakāśaṃ kuru śaṅkarakathayāmi varārohe susthirā bhava sarvadāpāyasaṃ kṣaudramāṃsaṃ ca nārikelaṃ samodakamrambhāphalaṃ laḍḍukaṃ ca bharjitānnaṃ ca piṣṭakammadgūraṃ ca baliṃ dadyāt māṃsaṃ māhiṣameṣakamkṛṣṇachāgaṃ mahāmāṃsaṃ godhikāṃ hariṇīṃ tathānānāvyañjanadagdhāni vyañjanāni madhūni cabaliṃ dadyāt viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇapakṣe śubhe dinemahiṣe dhanavṛddhiḥ syāt mṛge mokṣaphalaṃ bhavetnare datte maharddhiḥ syāt yataḥ siddhiranuttamāsvahṛdo rudhire datte rudradeha ivā'paraḥsurādānena deveśi mahāyogīśvaro bhavetkāñcikī ca mahādevi kathitā bhuvi durlabhāḍākinīdānayogena sarvavaśyo bhaved dhruvamguṭikāñjanastambhādimāraṇoccāṭanādibhiḥarghyodake maheśāni mahāsiddhiranuttamāarghyaṃ dattvā maheśāni sarvakāmārthasādhanampuraḥ pātraṃ ghaṭasyā'nte tadante bhojyapatrakampādyārghācamanīyānāṃ pātrāṇi sthāpayet budhaḥsvayambhūkusume datte bhavet ṣaṭkarmabhājanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṇḍagolo'tha bījairvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavetvidhavāratisambhūtaṃ golamṛddhipradaṃ bhuviarghyaṃ dadyāt viśeṣeṇa cakravātena pūjitāāṣoḍaśādanūḍhāyā uttamā sarvasiddhidābalātkāreṇa deveśi adhamā bhogavarddhinīākṛṣya baddhayogena golo'tha puṣpakaṃ nyasettāmrapātre kapāle vā śmaśānakāṣṭhanirmitesuvarṇe'pyatha lohe vā cakramarcyaṃ yathāvidhiśvetaraktaṃ javāpuṣpaṃ karavīraṃ tathā priyedhuttūrāśokabakulāḥ śvetakṛṣṇā'parājitāḥvahnikā jhiṇṭikā kañciraktaṃ yat parikīrtitamaṣṭamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa santuṣṭā tasya pārvatīpadmapuṣpeṇa raktena santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥśmaśānadhuttareṇaiva tuṣṭā madhumatī parāvanyapuṣpaiśca vividhaiḥ santuṣṭā pārvatī parāśmaśāne rātriśeṣe ca śanibhaumadine niśi|| iti dvitīye muṇḍamālātantre caturthaḥ paṭalaḥvadasva yadanuṣṭhānāt sarvakāmā bhavanti hiadhamo vaiṣṇavaḥ prokto madhyamaḥ śaivadīkṣitaḥcaturdaśasahasrāṇi sevito hariharātmakaḥkāyena manasā vācā suvarṇarajatādibhiḥpūrvoktasthānamāsādya japapūjāṃ samāśrayetprathame'hani yajjaptaṃ tajjaptavyaṃ dine dinegate prathamayāme tu tṛtīyapraharāvadhihaviṣyaṃ bhakṣayennityamekavāraṃ susaṃyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svastrīmanyastrīyaṃ vāpi pūjayet sarvaparvasuyasya yāvān pajaḥ proktaḥ taddaśāṃśamanukramāthomasya ca daśāṃśena tarpaṇaṃ proktameva cataddaśāṃśena viprendrān kurvīta kulakanyakāḥhomādyaśakto deveśi kuryācca dviguṇaṃ japamkevalaṃ japamātreṇa puraścaryā vidhīyatesvecchācāraparo bhūtvā ekānte sarvadā japetekārātrau śmaśāne vā śave vā prauḍhabālayoḥhastamātranikhāte vā kuṇḍe vā vijane vanekumārīpūjanādeva puraścaryāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥatyantaprauḍhā bālā vā kokilā varadāyinīpūjayet parabhāvena nānārūpamanoharāḥmātṛvarjaṃ sadā pūjyā nānājātisamudbhavākṛṣṇāṃ caturdaśīṃ prāpya navamyāṃ tu mahotsavetāvajjapte maheśāni puraścaryā vidhīyatesahasrasaṃkhye japte tu puraścaraṇamiṣyatedaśamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt matsyamāṃsādibhiḥ priyecaturdaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadanyā caturdaśīkevalaṃ japamātreṇa mantrāḥ siddhā bhavanti hiyonipīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāmapīṭhaṃ tathā'paramguroranugrahe caiva dīkṣākālaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ|| iti dvitīye muṇḍamālātantre pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥyāmārādhya purā sarve bhūtibhājo'bhavan surāḥśaktirmāyā maheśāni vidyā vasvakṣarā matāmahāmāyeti vikhyātā bījaṃ lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṅgāni tataḥ kuryāt māyādīrgheṇa saṃyutāvidyut puñjanibhāṃ devīṃ raktapadmāsane sthitāmpīta - rakta - śveta - kṛṣṇa - dhūmra - pāṭala - mauktikamkhaṅga - śūla - gadā - cakra - śaṅkha - cāpa - śarāṇi cakartṛmudrāṃ tathā yogamudrāṃ ca dadhatīṃ karaiḥpūjāyantraṃ pravakṣyāmi ṣaṭkoṇaṃ śaktisaṃyutamtrikoṇe pūjayed devīṃ māyāṃ vāṇīṃ haripriyāmyoganidrā mahānidrā mahāmāyā mahāsurīkṣemaṅkarī yogamudrā śarīrākarṣiṇī tathāaṣṭadale maheśāni vāmāvartena pūjayetsaumyā paramasaumyā ca mahāsaumyā mahāparāprakṛtirvikṛtirmeghā viśvarūpāḥ kramādimāḥmahāprahlādā bagalā pūjayed vidhinā tathāaṭṭāṭṭahāsinīṃ nityāṃ harṣeṇā'vihvalāṃ tathāghorarāvā mahānityā mahāmañjulabhāsinīindrādayastataḥ pūjyāḥ pūrvādidigvidikṣu cabhagadevī bhagākṣī ca vidhinā vāmavartmanāhomādividhinā kuryāt daśāṃśāt kramataḥ priyedhanavān putravān vāgmī sudhī bhogī mahābalaḥbhuvaneśī bhagavatī vahnijāyānvito manuḥsvarṇapadmanibhāṃ devīṃ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāmathavā siṃhaśailau ca indrādirathadevatāḥsarvakālaṃ tu tajjapyaṃ mantraṃ sarvasamṛddhidambrahmāmukhena saṃyukto dvirāvṛttamanukramāthṛdāyukto manurayaṃ sarvavidyāphalapradaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍdīrghabījādeva ṣaḍaṅgāni prakalpayetcaturhastāṃ trinayanāṃ śaśamāṃsakarāmbujāmkaricarmaparīdhānāṃ śuṣkamāṃsātibhairavāmnimagna - vartulā''rakta - nayana - traya - dhāriṇīmtrikoṇaṃ caturasraṃ tu ṣaṭkoṇaṃ navakoṇakamtrikoṇe pūjayed devīṃ pracaṇḍāṃ caṇḍanāyikāmkhaṭvāṃ mattāṃ kramād devi pūjayed vidhinā pathāaṭṭāṭṭahāsinīṃ nityāṃ pragalbhāṃ ghorarūpiṇīmatikālīṃ mahākālīṃ mahānityāṃ mahābhayāmmahāghorāṃ yajed devi dalān dikṣu vidikṣu caiyaṃ sā ṣoḍaśī proktā triśaktirabhidhīyatesecanīye dvayaṃ kūrcaṃ phaṭ svāhā ca tathā parebuddhibhāvaṃ tathāṅīya rudravat parikīrtitamnādabinduyutāṃ dvandvaṃ phaṭ svāhā tadanantaramoṃ lajjāṃ trapāṃ medhāṃ huṃ phaḍityugratārikārakāraṃ prathamaṃ rephacaturdaśasvarānvitamastrahīnamidaṃ nīlasarasvatyā vinirdiśetnārasiṃhastataḥ śvantaṃ śuddhaṃ kuryāttameva caturyamaṣṭottaramathavā ? punaruttaramsubhage vahnijāyāntaṃ mantramevaṃ prakīrtayetvārāhī śakrabījaṃ ca pañcasvaravibhūṣitamvārāhyā iti vikhyātā durlabhā śatrumāraṇenādabindusamāyuktastriśūlīkṛtavigrahaḥvāgbījavahnivanitā dakṣiṇāyā dviviṃśatiḥhanti piśācinī caiva tribhāṣāṃ tadāditaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etāsāmapi devīnāṃ jaṣahome ca tarpaṇedevatāgurumantrāṇāmaikyamāvaśyakāriṇaḥnityamadhyātmayoge ca sthirāt siddhimavāpnuyātśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mhāvidyāṃ mahākalāmvāntanetreṇa saṃyuktaṃ pāntena sahitaṃ priyesarvaiśvaryaprade vahnijāyānto manuruttamaḥdevatā śumbhamathanī sarvadevanamaskṛtāādyantabījayogena bījaśaktiśarīrakāmpakvabimbasamānāṅgīṃ cārucandranibhānanāmkoṭikoṭigaṇairarcyā pāśāṅkuśadhanuḥśarāncarmakhaḍgaṃ mahāyaṣṭiṃ kapālakarkaśān śarāntrikoṇāntaraṣaṭkoṇe dalāṣṭapariśobhiteṣaṭkoṇe pūjayed devīṃ kālīṃ caṇḍāṃ pracaṇḍikāmathā'ṣṭadalamadhye tu brāhyādimātaraḥ kramātnārasiṃhī tathā caindrī śivadūtī prabhedataḥindrādayastataḥ pūjyā dvāre nandimahābalaupañcalakṣaṃ japenmantraṃ taddhomādi daśāṃśataḥkevalaṃ tvatprayatnena kathitā kulasundarina kiñcit durlabhaṃ tasya triṣu lokeṣu vidyategoptavyaṃ tat prayatnena yasmai kasmai na vinyaset|| iti dvitīye muṇḍamālātantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00538 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
